item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2023 evidence that Putin tolerated independent investigation of his own conduct, concealed decisions, or self-enrichment. The available counterevidence is limited to formal complaint procedures and isolated disciplinary cases. There is no strong sign of independent courts, prosecutors, auditors, or media being allowed to function freely against the regime.","evidence":[{"title":"2023 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Russia","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"22 Apr 2024","url":"https://www.state.gov/reports/2023-country-reports-on-human-rights-practices/russia","summary":"The report says authorities denied independent investigations, used disinformation to obfuscate abuse allegations, and harassed NGOs, election monitors, and journalists.
